summary: GMEX Robotics Corp, a BVI-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-9 share consolidation and reduction of par value from US$0.8064 to US$0.000001, effective September 28, 2026, plus a principal office move to Bankstown Aerodrome, NSW. The board approved the actions on September 2, 2026, without shareholder vote under BVI law. Class A shares fall from 6,771,947 to roughly 752,439 and trade under new CUSIP G3514S161. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping measure, not a special situation; watch reverse-split dynamics and authorized-share overhang.
